question: Related Questions Q. My questions are related to dreams and I ask for interpretation, inshaAllah. 1. My mother dreamed a big snake and the snake told her, 'I will eat you'. After that the snake surrounded her body and my mother said, 'Only Allah can help me'. Then she recited Ayatul Kursi and the snake disappeared. 2. I dreamed my 70-year-old female Christian neighbour. I met her in the street at the time just before the sun raises /it wasn't neither dark, nor light/. The street was empty. My neighbour told me 'You will all burn in Hell even your young /innocent/ children'. In life she admires us and is tollerant but I am worried about what I saw in my dream. 3.
